title: 3 Hour Lake Tahoe Boat Tour
includes: Passenger Restrictions: No children under 6 years old or expecting mothers (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Step aboard our luxury Cobalt R6 bow rider for an exclusive Lake Tahoe adventure with Elite Charters. We offer more than just a boat ride; our private, captained excursions are personalized to your interests, whether you're seeking high-energy fun or a serene escape.Tour duration flexible.

Your Experience Includes: 
Tailored Sightseeing: Explore iconic spots like Emerald Bay, Meeks Bay, Rubicon Bay, and Rooster Rock.

Relaxation & Play: Enjoy swim stops, floating loungers, and inflatables. We provide extra anchor time in Emerald Bay for lounging and snacks.

Local Insight: Your expert captain shares fascinating stories of Tahoe’s history and landmarks.

Premium Comfort: Spacious seating for groups, a large built-in cooler, and all USCG-approved safety gear.

What to Bring:
Feel free to bring your own snacks and drinks. We recommend sunscreen, towels, swimsuits, and a warm jacket for the lake breeze.

Note: For safety, no children under 6 or pets allowed. 

Gratuities are appreciated!
